title: 11月8日补课：矿石出口溯源文件缺失与客户催货谈判
english: Missing origin records and shipment pressure

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 5分钟。分别以1.0倍速和0.72倍速跟读；重点读清traceability、declaration、escalation。
lines: Traceability
可追溯性
Origin declaration
原产地声明
Document discrepancy
文件差异
Due diligence
尽职调查
Supporting evidence
支持性证据
Shipment release
放行发运
Delivery commitment
交货承诺
Escalation
上报升级

modules.title: 10个高频词与短语
modules.hint: 5分钟。每个词组朗读三遍，随后不看原文翻译。
lines: Chain of custody
货物交接和流转记录链
Mine of origin
来源矿山
Batch reference number
批次编号
Exporter declaration
出口商声明
Documentary evidence
书面证明材料
Red flag
风险警示信号
Pending verification
等待核实
Hold the shipment
暂停发运
Customer delivery window
客户收货时间窗口
Corrective action plan
纠正措施计划

modules.title: 10个核心句
modules.hint: 6分钟。逐句跟读并将第一人称I换成we再次表达。
lines: We cannot confirm the mine of origin from the documents provided.
从已提供的文件中，我们无法确认来源矿山。
Please send the original supporting records, not just a revised summary.
请提供原始支持性记录，而不只是修改后的汇总表。
The batch reference must match across the warehouse and export documents.
仓库和出口文件上的批次编号必须一致。
This discrepancy must be investigated before shipment release.
必须在批准发运前调查这项差异。
A verbal assurance is not sufficient for our due diligence file.
口头保证不足以满足尽调档案要求。
We need an explanation of the missing custody record.
我们需要对缺失的交接记录作出解释。
Please do not change the declared origin without verified evidence.
没有核实证据，请不要修改所申报的原产地。
We will give the customer an honest update on the delivery risk.
我们会如实向客户通报交货风险。
Any revised delivery date must be approved and confirmed in writing.
任何调整后的交货日期都必须获批并书面确认。
We will proceed once the necessary review is complete.
必要审核完成后，我们才会继续办理。

modules.title: 数字、金额和交期口述
modules.hint: 5分钟。所有数字均为教学假设。复述两批合计重量、暂定价值与延误天数。
lines: Batch A contains 8.4 metric tons.
A批为8.4公吨。
Batch B contains 6.6 metric tons.
B批为6.6公吨。
The combined gross weight is 15 metric tons.
合计毛重15公吨。
The provisional contract value is 48,000 US dollars.
暂定合同金额为48,000美元。
The customer requests dispatch on November tenth.
客户要求11月10日发运。
The next available shipping slot is November twelfth.
下一个可用发运档期是11月12日。
That creates a two-day dispatch delay.
这会造成两天的发运延误。
We have three supporting documents but one missing transfer record.
我们已有三份支持文件，但缺少一份转运记录。
The internal review is due by four p.m. Kigali time.
内部审核应在基加利时间下午四点前完成。
The updated dispatch estimate is subject to carrier confirmation.
更新后的发运预估时间以承运人确认为准。

modules.title: 跟读与影子训练
modules.hint: 5分钟。跟读两遍，第三遍脱稿复述，要读出因果和转折。
lines: Before discussing loading, I need to clarify the source documentation.
讨论装货前，我需要先澄清来源文件。
The document trail should connect the mine, trader, warehouse and shipment.
文件链条应将矿山、贸易商、仓库和发运环节关联起来。
We identified a gap in the transfer records.
我们发现转运记录存在缺口。
This does not prove misconduct, but it does require verification.
这并不证明存在不当行为，但确实需要核实。
The customer needs an accurate explanation rather than an optimistic guess.
客户需要准确解释，而不是乐观猜测。
We can propose a revised date while the evidence is checked.
核验证据期间，我们可以建议调整交期。
If we cannot verify the information, the shipment will remain on hold.
如果无法核实信息，货物将继续暂停发运。
Please send the complete document pack before the next review call.
请在下次审核会议前发送完整文件包。

modules.title: 商务破冰
modules.hint: 3分钟。训练保持礼貌而不作无依据承诺。
lines: Thank you for joining this call at short notice.
感谢大家临时参加此次电话会议。
I hope the journey back from the warehouse went smoothly.
希望你们从仓库返回的路途顺利。
We understand the pressure on your delivery schedule.
我们理解交期压力。
Our goal is to resolve the issue with minimum disruption.
我们希望在尽量减少干扰的情况下解决问题。
Could we start by agreeing on the facts?
我们能否先核实事实？
After that, we can discuss practical alternatives.
之后我们可以讨论实际可行的替代方案。

modules.title: 负责任采购与来源核验
modules.hint: 6分钟。压力一：供应商要求先放货后补资料。重点是查原始证据和权责。
lines: Please identify the supplier responsible for each movement of this batch.
请指出这一批货每次流转对应的供应商。
Which document supports the declared mine of origin?
哪一份文件支持所申报的来源矿山？
Was this material consolidated with another batch?
这批矿石是否与其他批次混合过？
If so, please supply the separate batch and weight records.
如果混合过，请提供独立批次及重量记录。
We must preserve original records even when a correction is necessary.
即使需要更正，也必须保留原始记录。
A corrected declaration must be supported by verifiable facts.
更正声明必须以可核实事实为依据。
An unsigned note is not necessarily a complete handover record.
未签名便条未必构成完整的交接记录。
Who physically controlled the goods during the undocumented movement?
缺失记录的那段运输中谁实际控制货物？
Do not backdate records to make the file appear complete.
不要倒签日期来制造文件完整的假象。
We will escalate the issue to the responsible compliance officer.
我们会把问题上报负责的合规人员。

modules.title: 物流、押运与出口文件
modules.hint: 5分钟。压力二：司机等候装柜，可能错过航运档期。备货和放货必须分开。
lines: Please hold the container booking until the review is cleared.
审核通过前请暂缓集装箱订舱。
The packing list must reflect the verified shipment contents.
装箱单必须准确反映核实后的货物。
The export declaration must be consistent with the approved records.
出口申报应与批准的记录保持一致。
The escort team needs correct collection and handover references.
押运人员需要正确的提货和交接编号。
Do not attach documents belonging to another batch.
不要附上属于其他批次的单据。
Ask the freight forwarder about the next available departure.
向货代询问下一班可用发运时间。
A confirmed booking is different from a tentative reservation.
确认订舱与暂定预留不同。
The warehouse can prepare the goods without releasing them.
仓库可以备货，但不得因此放货。
Please keep a log of every change to the document pack.
请记录文件包的每一项变更。
After approval, notify the transporter and customer using consistent final details.
获批后用一致的最终信息通知运输方和客户。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 15分钟。三轮各5分钟：供应商逼签、客户催货、物流催装。先独立回答，再核对示范。
lines: Supplier: We can provide the missing transfer record after the truck leaves.
供应商：车开走以后我们会补交接记录。
Manager: We cannot authorize release before the evidence is reviewed.
经理：审核证据前不能批准放货。
Supplier: Everyone knows the goods came from an approved mine.
供应商：大家都知道这些货来自获批矿山。
Manager: I need verifiable records, not personal assurances.
经理：我需要可核实的记录，而不只是个人保证。
Supplier: Just change the origin field so that the documents match.
供应商：直接改一下原产地字段，文件就对上了。
Manager: We will not change an origin declaration without supporting evidence.
经理：没有支持证据，我们不会修改原产地声明。
Customer: Your promised dispatch is tomorrow. Are the goods ready?
客户：你们承诺明天发货，货准备好了吗？
Manager: The goods are ready, but one transfer record remains under review.
经理：货已经备好，但有一份交接记录仍在审核。
Customer: Can you guarantee delivery this week?
客户：你能保证本周交货吗？
Manager: Not yet. I will send a confirmed update after our review.
经理：目前不能保证。审核后我会发送经确认的进度。
Customer: We may charge you a late-delivery penalty.
客户：我们可能收取延期交货违约金。
Manager: Please identify the contract clause so that we can assess the exposure.
经理：请指出合同条款，以便我们评估责任。
Logistics: The driver is waiting and the container slot may be lost.
物流：司机等着呢，舱位可能丢掉。
Manager: Please check the next slot while the shipment hold remains in place.
经理：请查询下一个档期，同时继续暂停放货。
Logistics: Should we load without updating the packing list?
物流：不更新装箱单直接装柜吗？
Manager: No. Loading and release require written authorization.
经理：不行。装柜和放货需要书面授权。
Supplier: Who will decide this issue today?
供应商：今天谁能决定这件事？
Manager: Compliance will review the evidence and an authorized manager will approve release.
经理：合规部门审核证据，有权经理决定是否放行。
Manager: I will send a written action list with an owner and deadline for each item.
经理：我会发出书面行动清单，明确每项责任人和期限。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 4分钟。先点读，遮住英文写下来，再展开核对。
lines: The declared mine of origin must be supported by credible evidence.
申报的来源矿山必须有可信证据支持。
We found a missing transfer record in the chain of custody.
我们发现流转记录链中缺少一份交接记录。
The warehouse has prepared the bags but has not released them.
仓库已经备好吨包，但尚未放货。
Please confirm the revised dispatch date in writing.
请书面确认调整后的发运日期。
We will update the customer after the compliance review.
合规审核结束后，我们会更新客户。

modules.title: 5道口语问答
modules.hint: 4分钟。每题独立用45秒作答，核对示范答案。
lines: Question: What if the mine of origin cannot be verified? Answer: I hold the shipment and escalate the missing evidence.
问：无法核实来源矿山怎么办？答：暂停发运并上报证据缺口。
Question: How do you respond to a backdating request? Answer: I refuse and require an accurate correction supported by records.
问：供应商要求倒签怎么办？答：拒绝，并要求据实更正和提供记录。
Question: What do you tell an impatient customer? Answer: I state confirmed facts, risks and the next update time.
问：对着急的客户怎么说？答：告知确认事实、风险及下一次更新时间。
Question: May the warehouse prepare the goods while shipment is on hold? Answer: Yes, if this does not break the hold or constitute unauthorized loading.
问：暂停发运时可以备货吗？答：只要不违反暂停要求或擅自装货，就可以。
Question: What belongs in a corrective action plan? Answer: Missing records, responsible persons, deadlines, evidence and approvals.
问：整改计划包含什么？答：缺失记录、责任人、期限、证据和批准情况。

modules.title: 前课知识迁移
modules.hint: 3分钟。将Day26的封签和付款问题与今天的来源问题联系起来，脱稿复述。
lines: A matching seal number does not replace evidence of origin.
封签号一致不能替代来源证明。
A valid origin document does not excuse a broken seal.
有效来源文件也不能成为忽略破损封签的理由。
A payment deadline must not override verification controls.
付款截止期限不能凌驾于核验控制之上。
We should document facts, risks and authorization separately.
我们应分别记录事实、风险和授权。
Urgency changes our response speed, not our evidence standard.
紧迫性可以改变响应速度，但不能降低证据标准。

modules.title: 完整工作汇报
modules.hint: 5分钟。不看中文连续陈述90秒，再录音回听并纠正表达。
lines: Good afternoon. I am reporting a documentation gap affecting a planned mineral shipment.
下午好，我汇报影响计划矿石发运的一项文件缺口。
The warehouse has prepared the goods and confirmed the physical batch references.
仓库已经备好货并确认实物批次编号。
However, one custody transfer record is missing from our document pack.
但是文件包中缺少一份货物流转交接记录。
We have not established whether this affects the declared origin.
我们尚未确定这是否影响所申报的来源信息。
For that reason, the shipment remains on hold pending review.
因此审核完成前，这批货维持暂停发运。
We asked the supplier for original supporting evidence.
我们要求供应商提供原始支持证据。
The compliance officer will assess the complete record trail.
合规负责人将评估完整的记录链条。
Meanwhile, logistics is checking alternative dispatch slots.
同时物流正在查询其他发运档期。
We will provide the customer with a factual written update.
我们会向客户提供基于事实的书面更新。
I will escalate any unresolved risk to the authorized decision-maker.
我会把尚未解决的风险上报有权决策者。
Our priorities are accurate records, responsible sourcing and reliable delivery commitments.
我们的重点是准确记录、负责任采购及可靠的交付承诺。

modules.title: 完成清单
modules.hint: 4分钟。不看英文逐条自检，最后用英语回答第9模块第三轮问题。
lines: I can explain a chain-of-custody gap in English.
我能用英语解释交接记录缺口。
I can request source records without accusing a supplier.
我能在不指责供应商的情况下索取来源记录。
I can refuse an inaccurate origin declaration.
我能拒绝不准确的原产地申报。
I can inform customers of a delay without making false promises.
我能不作虚假承诺地向客户说明延误。
I can distinguish goods preparation from shipment authorization.
我能区分备货与发运授权。
I can report compliance and delivery risks to management.
我能向管理层汇报合规与交付风险。
